name: nonApi_getPendingTrackImports
description: Internal, no auth. The timer backstop's worklist (E5.F5.S7), read by ProcessTrackImportsNightly (api/Endpoints/TrackImportFunctions.cs): HC.TrackImport jobs the phone never finished driving — Status 0 (uploaded, never started) or 1 (processing) whose StartedAt is NULL or more than @staleMinutes ago. Oldest UploadedAt first. Read only.

parameters.name: staleMinutes
parameters.description: How long a claimed slice may run before the job counts as abandoned. Default 15. NULL makes the StartedAt comparison unknown, so only never-started jobs are returned.

rowsets.name: PendingJobs
rowsets.description: Zero or more jobs, ORDER BY UploadedAt ASC.

columns.name: blobUrl
columns.description: HC.TrackImport.BlobUrl — the uploaded file in the track-imports container.

columns.name: nextIndex
columns.description: HC.TrackImport.NextIndex — activities before this index are done; the processor resumes here.

columns.name: resultJson
columns.description: HC.TrackImport.ResultJson — the itemised result so far, appended to on resume.

sideEffects: None (read only). On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<unknown>') then THROW.

codeSmells.issue: Header names a column that does not exist
codeSmells.detail: Line 10 says the rowset returns 'cursor'; the SQL returns nextIndex (line 20) — 'Cursor' is a reserved word and the column was named NextIndex.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
